item.title: Avid RC Carpet Tires Teaser
item.description: Avid Racing Concepts debuted their prototype carpet tires at the 2025 US Carpet Off-Road Championships, check out some teaser photos from the Scotty Ernst Productions crew.

item.title: New Revolution Design HD B7 C-Blocks
item.description: Revolution Design's HD Suspension Mount C for Team Associated's latest T7 and SC7 trucks, as well as updated B7 buggies equipped with the new 3-gear transmission, is a must-have upgrade for racers looking for enhanced durability and tuning options.

item.title: Hudy Arena to Host 2027 IFMAR 1/10th Off-Road World Championships
item.description: Important announcement regarding the 2027 IFMAR Electric Off-Road Buggy World Championships. Hudy Arena will host the event in 2027.

item.title: New SMJ Racing RS Series Lefty 1/8th GP Springs
item.description: The long-awaited RS series has been added to the lineup of the standard “SMJ Stealth Line Lefty Springs” for 1/8 GP racing car shock absorbers.

item.title: Adam Drake Explains Soft Mounting Electronics [VIDEO]
item.description: Adam Drake took some time this week to talk about how to soft mount electronics and potentially make them last longer.

item.title: New Infinity Speciale Low Friction Belts and Titanium Upper Pivot Ball Studs
item.description: Infinity has released low friction pulleys for the Speciale Touring Car as well as titanium upper pivot ball studs.

item.title: New Team Xray XB2/XB4 Titanium Shock Stand-Offs
item.description: XRAY Titanium Shock Standoffs - Long are ultra-precisely machined from high grade titanium material.

item.title: New Powerstar PL-8012D Digital Low Profile Drift Servo
item.description: POWERSTAR has released their newest servo, PL-8012D, DC Motor Digital Low Profile Drift Servo in Black.

item.title: New RC Discharger 4S Off-Road Air Travel Version
item.description: RC Discharger is thrilled to introduce the all-new Regenerative Discharger 4S Off-Road – Air Travel Version, the ultimate solution for racers on the go!

item.title: 2025 US Carpet Off-Road Championships Results
item.description: Check out the results from the 2025 Scotty Ernst Productions US Carpet Off-Road Championships held this past weekend in Cleveland, Ohio with 488 entires.
